question: Who is situated in the middle of the void and what is her essential nature?
premises: A goddess is situated in the middle of the void.
Her nature is that of the kāma-bīja.
inference: The goddess situated in the middle of the void has the essential nature of the kāma-bīja.
plain_english: In the middle of the void is situated the goddess, whose essential nature is the kāma-bīja.
